Vapor Sear.name: Vapor Sear
Vapor Sear.description: The user presses two fingers to a lock, a frozen pipe or an attacker's weapon and vents a needle of wet heat at contact, narrower than a Fire user's furnace press and unable to ignite dry fuel. It softens plastic, thaws ice or deals fire damage to a hand so the target drops their weapon; held back, it only warms metal too hot to grip without burning skin, and cold air weakens it. Strain: moderate.
